scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd apps/api && uv sync && cd ../.. && docker compose up -d redis
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d redis && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api,worker --prefix-colors blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn --factory app.main:create_app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run arq app.workers.settings.WorkerSettings --watch app
scripts.check: pnpm run check:api && pnpm run check:web
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter web format:check && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.fmt: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter web format
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -m "not integration"
scripts.test:int: cd apps/api && uv run pytest -m integration
scripts.gen-api: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.openapi_export && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter web gen-api
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.dbtasks push
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.dbtasks seed
